# Refusal codes

Every code `check` and its siblings can emit. `code` is stable — branch on it.
`expected` in the verdict is the concrete fix for that instance; the guidance
column is the general one.

## Refusals (exit 1)

| code | row | meaning | fix |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `activation-failed` | activation | activate(ctx) threw or rejected | activate must complete within its deadline and register only declared ids |
| `activation-leak` | activation | deactivation left a timer or handle running (§24.2 leak row) | clear every timer/listener in the disposable activate returns (or ctx.track it) |
| `artifact-hash-mismatch` | registry | `the artifact's sha256 is not what the index pins (PLUGIN_ARTIFACT_MISMATCH)` | re-pack and re-pin: the index pins the bytes, and a mismatch is never installed |
| `artifact-missing` | artifact | the manifest declares an entry module that is not on disk | run `plugin-build`, or fix entries.<renderer\|service> to name what it builds |
| `artifact-unmappable-specifier` | artifact | the bundle imports a bare specifier the host import map cannot bind (§11.6) | `import only HOST_SINGLETON_MODULE_SPECIFIERS, or let the plugin bundle it in` |
| `behavior-presence-budget-exceeded` | manifest | the plugin's charged ephemeral facets exceed one renderer presence window | reduce maxFacetBytes claims or remove optional presence producers; the whole plugin set must fit 48 KiB including per-facet envelopes |
| `behavior-store-unsupported` | manifest | a legacy host release does not admit this behavior store | upgrade the host; current releases admit bounded ephemeral behaviors and no longer emit this code |
| `binding-missing` | activation | the manifest declares a widget type that activate never bound (§12.1) | bind every declared type: ctx.widgets.register({ type, binding }) |
| `binding-undeclared` | activation | activate registered a widget type the manifest does not declare (§12.1) | declare the type under contributes.widgets, or register the declared type |
| `dev-root-unknown` | dev-link | no dev-linked plugin root could be resolved for this machine | `pass --root <dir>, or run inside the repo whose dev session watches examples/plugins` |
| `docs-stale` | docs | the committed docs are not what the current schemas generate | regenerate with `pnpm gen:docs` and commit the result |
| `harness-error` | harness | the kit itself failed — a bug here, not in the plugin (exit 2) | report it with the detail line; the plugin is not implicated |
| `index-invalid` | registry | the index bytes are not a RegistryIndex | generate it with the kit; the shape is RegistryIndex in @vibefield/contracts |
| `index-unreadable` | registry | the registry index could not be read from the given path or url | `pass --index <path to index.json>; its detached signature must sit beside it` |
| `key-unreadable` | registry | the signing key file could not be read, or is not a base64 DER Ed25519 secret key | generate one with generateRegistryKeypair(); the file holds the base64 secretKey |
| `link-exists` | dev-link | the target link name is taken by something this command did not create | remove it first, or re-run with --remove to unlink what the kit linked |
| `manifest-invalid` | manifest | the manifest fails PluginManifestV1 — one verdict per zod issue | the verdict's pointer names the failing field; expected states the passing shape |
| `manifest-missing` | manifest | the plugin directory has no vibefield.plugin.json | run `pnpm gen:manifest` in the plugin (the manifest is emitted from manifest.ts) |
| `manifest-stale` | manifest | the committed vibefield.plugin.json is not the canonical emission of itself | re-emit with `pnpm gen:manifest`; never hand-edit the canonical artifact |
| `manifest-unreadable` | manifest | vibefield.plugin.json is not parseable JSON, or exceeds the manifest byte limit | emit it with plugin-build's emitManifest rather than hand-editing |
| `module-shape-invalid` | activation | the renderer entry's default export has no activate(ctx) function | export default defineRendererPlugin({ activate(ctx) { … } }) |
| `module-unloadable` | activation | the built renderer entry exists but throws while being imported | module top-level must not perform product work (§10.1) — do it in activate(ctx) |
| `pack-refused` | pack | the .vfplugin bundle could not be produced (unsafe entry name, missing entry) | `pack walks vibefield.plugin.json + dist/** + assets/** — keep entries inside them` |
| `plugin-dir-invalid` | input | the path given is not a directory holding a plugin | pass the directory that holds vibefield.plugin.json |
| `release-not-found` | registry | the index carries no entry for the requested plugin id | check the id, or submit the plugin to the index first |
| `schema-invalid` | schema | a declared settings or service JSON Schema does not compile | the schema must compile under ajv (draft-07 style, `strict: false`) as the daemon compiles it |
| `signature-invalid` | registry | the detached signature does not verify against the index bytes | re-sign the EXACT bytes on disk; verification never re-canonicalizes |
| `signature-missing` | registry | no detached index.json.sig beside the index | sign the index with `vibefield-plugin index sign <index> --key <secret>` |
| `systems-contribution-superseded` | manifest | the retired contributes.systems shape cannot express an ICE behavior descriptor | define through @vibefield/plugin-sdk/behavior and declare under contributes.behaviors |
| `usage` | input | the command line could not be understood | run `vibefield-plugin --help`; every command is non-interactive |
| `wall-violation` | wall | plugin runtime code imports something outside the SDK door (§11.3, wall R10) | import @vibefield/plugin-sdk (+ /ui, /canvas, /behavior), @vibefield/contracts types, or react |

## Notes (exit 0)

A note is a row that could not run, or a fact worth saying. It never fails a
command — honest absence beats a blank.

| code | row | meaning | what it suggests |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `activation-not-loadable-here` | activation | the bundle needs a browser graph (JSX/CSS/ICE) that plain Node cannot import | the playground runs these rows against a real engine; the CLI reports honestly |
| `activation-unbuilt` | activation | no built renderer entry on disk, so binding and leak rows could not run | run `plugin-build` first if you want these rows; `check` never requires a build |
| `artifact-absent` | artifact | no dist/ — artifact rows were skipped, which is not a failure | run `plugin-build` to produce dist/ before packing or publishing |
| `artifact-singleton-build-time` | artifact | duplicate-singleton detection (PA-29) needs the bundler's module list, so it runs in plugin-build, not here | run `plugin-build`; it refuses a bundle that swallowed a host singleton |
| `dev-link-next-steps` | dev-link | what closes the loop after linking — developer mode, then plugins.reload | the copy is what the daemon re-reads, so re-run dev-link after each build |
| `dev-root-chosen` | dev-link | which dev-linked root the command used, and why that one | pass --root to choose a different one; the order is flag, env, repo default |
| `link-missing` | dev-link | --remove found nothing to unlink | nothing to do — the plugin is not dev-linked under this root |
| `manifest-dev-alias-id` | manifest | a single-segment dev-era id — valid locally, refused by distribution (§6.1) | use a dotted, distributable id (`vendor.plugin`) before publishing |
| `manifest-unknown-key` | manifest | a top-level or contributes key the schema does not know (preserved, ungranted) | remove it, or land the contribution kind in @vibefield/contracts first |
| `submit-artifact-url-placeholder` | registry | the emitted index row's artifactUrl is a placeholder, not a real location | replace it with the release asset's url before opening the index PR |
| `submit-index-repo-absent` | registry | the index repository does not exist yet, so submitting is a human step | keep the row; add it to registry/index.json and sign it when the repo exists |
